text.tspan: onboard: SGM6029C buck (BAT → 3V3), Li-ion charger on BAT (blocked by D1),
user LED GPIO15 (active-LOW), RF-switch power GPIO3 (10k pull-up, LOW = on)
GOAL BEAM (R_LED, R_LED_B, R_PU socketed: calibration knobs)
Emitter and receiver face each other across the
40 mm ball channel, 17 mm above the floor, Ø3 apertures.
BEAM_RX: D8/GPIO19 counts (digital edges), D2/GPIO2 reads it (ADC, beam health), each through 1 kΩ.
Modes: a = D3+D9 (220k, 1 mA; default) · a_boost = + D10 (220k, ≈ 6 mA; per table if needed) · b = all four (52k, ≈ 6 mA).
2.8–3.1 V on USB, 0 V on batteries
SND = XIAO MTDO back pad (GPIO7), wire pre-soldered.
LEDC square, notes 1–2 kHz, HIGH = coil on.
BTN = XIAO MTMS back pad (GPIO4), wire pre-soldered.
ext1 wake on LOW (with INT1 / USB sense HIGH).
The 1 kΩ at the switch makes a lead plugged
J_OLED order SCL G SDA V, pin 5 pulled (keyed).
Module pins by its silk. Not power-gated;
sleep = 0xAE, charge pump off: ≈ 5–20 µA with its LDO.
STAT = XIAO MTDI back pad (GPIO5), wire pre-soldered.
J_STAT RA / S / GND; R_R on the board, R_G at the green LED.
Never a yellow-green: its lower Vf leaks + glows.
